title: Thank You (Short |  5K Pledges)
description: This recording was first released during the Summer of 2018 — as thanks to those supporting Shibby — and marking a major milestone on Patreon. With the upcoming rebrand of my Patreon, I want to take the opportunity to look back over my Home feed and include some of the most memorable moments here. So I'll be sharing a few audios to reminisce over past posts, and perhaps showcase things you may have missed over the many years. Thank You I hit 5k in pledges! Holy shit. I have been smiling so much lately just thinking about it. I feel successful, and I never thought I would be lucky enough to have this feeling doing something I enjoyed. Unfortunately, I had a cold last week, so the big grand thank you audio I had planned just wasn't going to happen. I have to feel sexy to write sexy, and my voice sounded like an eighty-year old smoking grandpa. I'm feeling a lot better now. Thank you for all your well wishes, they made me smile — and last night I made a short thank you in audio form. It's not sexual, you pervs. I just felt I needed to say thank you in a way that's a bit more intimate then text. After recording the thank you, while going to export it, I realized I'd already made one a bit back when I hit five hundred patrons that somehow got lost. So umm... Thank you twice! Original Post I had a nice long audio thank you planned out for this point, but currently my voice is shot from this summer cold, so I'll hold off on that until I feel and sound sexy again. So be a good boy and give me a bit of a rain check on that. ;) In the meantime, just know this means a lot to me. You guys are awesome, and have completely changed my life in all positive ways. Because of you, I have been able to follow my passions, and truly become someone I am happy and proud to be. I hope I do the same for you a bit. ♡
author: Mistress Shibby
